# Artefact manifest (generated by scripts/showcase.py -- do not edit)

`out/` is the working directory every generator writes to. `docs/` and `outputs/` are
the submission surface: the same files, at the paths the rubric's Phase 8 checklist
names. They are copies, so editing one by hand is pointless -- re-run
`python scripts/showcase.py` instead.
